snippet.title: Crescent Break - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
We are thrilled to announce our newest game, Crescent Break! It is an action-roguelike platformer set in a futuristic world that has been taken over by robots. There are many unique weapons and stack-able upgrades leading to fun, chaotic gameplay! It is heavily influenced by MegaMan, as well as more modern games like Nuclear Throne and Speleunky. WISHLIST NOW!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4297720/Crescent_Break/
